0022600016.text: Chicago (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) visits Boston (3-1, winners of three straight) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, with the Bulls 4th in the Central and 11th in the East while the Celtics sit 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East. Boston is 3-0 at home and Chicago is 1-2 on the road, and the Celtics beat the Bulls 134-99 in Boston on October 26, leaving Chicago trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after the Bulls lost 1-2 in 2025-26. Nic Claxton, Patrick Williams and Tobe Awaka are out for the Bulls, and Devin Carter is out for the Celtics.
